title: Nasi Lemak $12.90, Aug 25 & 26 @ PappaRich (Excludes Sydney Airport)
body:
Deal: Nasi Lemak $12.90, Aug 25 & 26 @ PappaRich (Excludes Sydney Airport)

[JacobAU] Their Nasi Lemak’s are so good definitely worth a shot
[shanlee] You haven't tried other Malaysian restaurants. Papparich's quality has gone downhill, and they have closed many outlets.
Many non-fancy malaysian restuarants tastes much better (a couple of shops in Springvale, boxhill, if you're in Mel)
[AllyOop] Melbourne has a huge Malaysian population I'm not surprised they can't compete. However, most major Australian cities don't have access to as many Malaysian options so Papparich has their place.
[UncommonName] Which Malaysian restaurants in Springvale, mate?
[samehada] https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nasi_lemak
"One legend tells the story of a young girl named Seri in Malacca who accidentally spilled coconut milk into rice while she was cooking for her mother. When the latter asked her what she was preparing, the daughter replied, "Nasi le, mak" ("just rice, Mom")"
[whyisave] Gemini:
The Malay word lemak literally means "fat".
In cooking, it describes a rich, creamy taste and texture from coconut milk (santan).
It is most famous as part of nasi lemak, the iconic Malay dish of rice cooked in coconut milk and pandan leaves.
https://guide.michelin.com/en/article/dining-out/what-is-lem…
[dlovep] So.. we have a 'Fat rice' vs 'Rice, Fat Mum'…
[gurgle166] Wow this is really good, I love nasi lemak and yeah it usually costs a lot more than this. PappaRich isn't the best out there but it's fine, I'm not complaining.
Also sometimes nasi lemak can be served without any large protein component, just whatever is in say the anchovies, sambal, and half egg. So those are cheaper. But no, this one comes with curry chicken etc as well.
[JacobAU] The curry chicken was really good when I tried at southern cross the other day. Tempted to try a different option this time but will probably go curry chicken again 😅
[Nicles] $20.50 for the fried and curry chicken normally
[yeahna] Anyone tried the vegetarian option? Any good?
[penguinswillrise] Ironically saw this sign near sydney airport
[IlIlIl IlI llIIIl] Nan Yang under $7 for basic nasi lemak. Haven't tried as I go for their $10 meals most of the time
[ChaLuo] Nasi lemak is a simple dish that's easy to get right. Problem is the availability/cost of fresh Pandan leaves in Melbourne.
Next.. the beef rendang is also a relatively simple thing.. Ideally the "kerisik" uses fresh dessicated coconut. Again not easy to find here.
Any Nasi lemak in Melbourne is fine. Haven't encountered a terrible one as it's almost impossible to screw up.
[Adikp3njahat] It's wild that nowadays $12.90 is considered bargain. I miss those days when this was something we can get below $10
[INFIDEL] Wild?? 90c increase over 2025 popular Deal
Compared with usual price @PR ($20.50), it is a bargain.
Eaten @PR for $10 many years of these Deals
Never below $10 where I live.
So cheap in Malaysia, but got to add the airfare.
[gstfree] It has been always $10 at Nanyang Food Stall at Preston VIC.
